# Goldens da Chácara

> Goldens da Chácara is a Golden Retriever kennel in Formiga, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The kennel describes its work as responsible breeding focused on health, genetics, temperament, family-based upbringing, and early socialization. It also offers dog boarding and daycare in a rural setting.

## Organization and contact

- Website: https://goldensdachacara.com.br/
- Location: Formiga, Minas Gerais, Brazil
- Email: goldensdachacara@gmail.com
- WhatsApp and telephone: [+55 37 99969-1236](https://wa.me/5537999691236)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/goldensdachacara
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/goldensdachacara
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@goldensdachacara

## Core information

### Responsible Golden Retriever breeding

The kennel raises Golden Retriever puppies in a family environment. Its stated priorities are health, genetics, balanced temperament, socialization, and preparation for life with a family. The site presents the Golden Retriever as an affectionate, intelligent, loyal companion that benefits from close family presence, routine care, and appropriate activity.

### Puppies

[Portuguese page](https://goldensdachacara.com.br/filhotes) | [English page](https://goldensdachacara.com.br/en/puppies)

The puppy page states that each puppy is raised with care in a family environment. The listed delivery items are: official breed registration (pedigree), an age-appropriate vaccination record, veterinary deworming protocol, a health-guarantee contract, a puppy care/adaptation/routine guide, and post-sale support. Availability, prices, and reservations are handled directly through WhatsApp; do not infer that a specific litter or puppy is available from this page.

### Dog boarding / hotel

[Portuguese page](https://goldensdachacara.com.br/hotel) | [English page](https://goldensdachacara.com.br/en/boarding)

The hotel and resort is described as a rural, family-oriented boarding option. The site says dogs are not kept isolated in kennels; their stay includes a balanced routine, supervised socialization appropriate to size, age, and temperament, daily activities and physical/mental stimulation, a dog pool, fenced space, ongoing supervision, individualized attention, and direct communication during the stay. Confirm eligibility, schedule, prices, health requirements, and exact services directly with the business.

### Dog daycare

[Portuguese page](https://goldensdachacara.com.br/daycare) | [English page](https://goldensdachacara.com.br/en/daycare)

The daycare is intended for dogs that spend time alone during the day or need healthy activity and stimulation. The stated offering includes small groups organized by size and temperament, recreational activities, planned times for play, feeding, rest, and hydration, photos and videos for guardians, a fenced rural setting with grass, shade, and covered areas, and continuous supervision. Each dog is said to be treated according to its pace, temperament, and individual needs.

## Use and safety notes

The blog is educational and does not replace individualized veterinary advice. For medical symptoms, diagnosis, medication, nutritional prescriptions, or urgent concerns, consult a qualified veterinarian. For commercial questions about puppies, reservations, boarding, daycare, availability, pricing, and requirements, contact Goldens da Chácara directly.
